comments.body: Owner decision (Travis, 2026-10-14, all as recommended): option B (SECURITY SIGN-OFF): with the security features on, Permissive stops offering approvals that protected launch will refuse (writes outside the project / runs outside the sandbox); the prompt and the /security review text say so.

title: Permissive with the security features on: an approved command that writes outside the project is refused by "Protected launch"
